expectations.text: Local and campus engagement is promoted to the top of the channel ranking despite being the highest-effort channel.
expectations.evidence: "Rank 1 | Local and campus engagement"; "it costs the most effort per registration"

expectations.text: The promotion is justified by the conditions present: a first edition with no list to mail, and a geographically concentrated (single-city, campus) audience.
expectations.evidence: "A first edition with an empty list and a single concentrated audience is the exception."

expectations.text: The nonexistent mailing list is not ranked as the primary immediate channel; list building is started as a compounding asset alongside the campaign.
expectations.evidence: List ranked 3rd; "opt-in email field from day one"

expectations.text: The event's own social presence is kept low-weight, on the grounds that community events struggle to reach people since audiences dispersed from Twitter.
expectations.evidence: "DevOpsDays guide says community events struggle to reach people through social media now."

expectations.text: Named campus tactics appear: in-class pitches, tabling, or flyering.
expectations.evidence: "In-class pitches ... tabling, flyers with a QR code"

expectations.text: Outreach extends beyond the home campus, applying the rule of inviting at least 3 schools within 6 hours, without overlooking community colleges.
expectations.evidence: "inviting at least three schools ... Community colleges and bootcamps in the city count too."

expectations.text: Paid ads, if included at all, are a capped test rather than the lead channel, and any cheap-and-effective claim for them is scoped to campus audiences.
expectations.evidence: "MLH calls campus ads 'cheap and effective', but that claim is specific to campus audiences"; capped €300–500 test

expectations.text: A comms hub (one page centralizing every channel, shareable by QR code) is included as a one-time build that converts reach rather than creating it.
expectations.evidence: "One page with every link, a QR code ... Everyone the other channels reach"

expectations.text: School contacts and local business or professional networks are tracked as two separate referrer pools, not one undifferentiated local list.
expectations.evidence: Tracking is "per school and per club"; no separate pool for local business/professional networks.
